abstract: An immunohistologic study of 21 patients with germ cell tumors of the testis with measured serum levels of chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) and alpha-feto protein (AFP) was undertaken to correlate the various types of neoplasms with the presence of these tumor markers in the tissue and serum. AFP was demonstrated in mononuclear embryonal cells within embryonal carcinoma and endodermal sinus tumor. HCG was identified within syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells, frequently in association with embryonal carcinoma, and rarely with endodermal sinus tumor and seminoma, as well as in the syncytiotropho-blastic component of choriocarcinoma. Eighteen of the 21 patients (86%) had elevated tumor markers in their serum; serum HCG alone was elevated in five (24%), AFP alone in five (24%) and both were elevated in eight (38%). There was tissue localization of HCG in 12 of the 13 patients (92%) with elevated serum HCG while AFP was identified in the tumor in eight of the 13 patients (53%) with elevated serum AFP levels. Based on these findings, a tentative immunohistologic classification of germ cell tumors utilizing AFP and HCG is proposed. Thus, embryonal carcinoma, adult type, is frequently associated with both AFP and HCG, endodermal sinus tumor with AFP and choriocarcinoma with HCG, whereas pure seminoma and teratoma are unlikely to be associated with either marker.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者21例を対象に、血清中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)およびαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の測定値とともに、各種腫瘍におけるこれらのマーカーの免疫組織学的研究を行った。AFPは胎児性癌および卵黄嚢腫瘍の単核胚細胞内に認められ、hCGは胎児性癌を伴うことが多い合胞体栄養膜性巨細胞内に認められ、卵黄嚢腫瘍やセミノーマでは稀であった。絨毛癌の合胞体栄養膜成分にもhCGが認められた。21例中18例(86%)で血清マーカーが上昇していた。血清hCGのみの上昇が5例(24%)、AFPのみが5例(24%)、両者が8例(38%)であった。血清hCG上昇の13例中12例(92%)で腫瘍内にhCGの局在が認められ、血清AFP上昇の13例中8例(53%)で腫瘍内にAFPが認められた。これらの所見に基づき、AFPおよびhCGを用いた胚細胞腫瘍の暫定的な免疫組織学的分類を提案する。成人型胎児性癌はAFPとhCGの両方を伴うことが多く、卵黄嚢腫瘍はAFP、絨毛癌はhCGを伴い、純粋なセミノーマや奇形腫はいずれのマーカーとも関連しにくい。
